title: CUBE Agent Input v1
description: What the orchestrator sends an agent (POST /run).

request_id.description: Idempotency key. Same request_id, same record_id.

stage.description: The current stage, which is also the agent being called.

route.description: fba: Prep then Amazon ships. mfn: merchant-fulfilled / 3PL, seller packs.

inputs.description: This stage's captures / report rows, content-addressed.

data_base64.description: Optional inline base64 image data for Pack inputs; decoded image size is limited to 8 MiB.

previous_evidence.description: Every Evidence Record already produced in this workflow, in stage order. Read-only. Empty for the first stage.

context.description: Stage information and hints. The orchestrator always adds context.overrides: workflow-level overrides of previous evidence (use the latest as effective).
